7_hosted_proof.probe_python:
import gzip, json, sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from services.source_ingestion.daily_bars_store import KEYED_DATASETS, keyed_dataset_store
from services.source_ingestion.finmind_broker_backfill import read_whole_market_receipt, traded_share_symbols
from services.source_ingestion.routers.ingest_operations import _broker_flow_row
root, day = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
store = keyed_dataset_store(root, "tw_broker_top")
assert store.declaration.retention_sessions == 750 and store.declaration.retention_days is None, "session retention not deployed"
receipt = read_whole_market_receipt(root, day)
assert receipt and receipt["status"] == "complete" and receipt["fresh"] is True, "no complete receipt"
verified = store.verify_partition(day)
assert verified["verified"], verified.get("reason")
del verified
manifest = store.read_manifest(day)
sides = defaultdict(set)
rows = uncompressed = compressed = compact_rows = 0
for entry in manifest["files"]:
    path = store.base / entry["path"]
    compressed += path.stat().st_size
    with gzip.open(path, "rb") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            uncompressed += len(line)
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            rec = json.loads(line)
            row = _broker_flow_row(rec)
            assert row and row["date"] == day and 1 <= row["rank"] <= 20, "unreadable broker row"
            meta = rec["metadata"]
            assert meta["license_scope"] == "vendor_research" and meta["redistribution_allowed"] is False
            compact_rows += isinstance(meta.get("normalized_row"), dict)
            sides[row["symbol"]].add(row["side"])
            rows += 1
assert len(sides) >= 1000 and all(s == {"buy", "sell"} for s in sides.values()), "insufficient two-sided coverage"
expected = traded_share_symbols(root, day)
assert expected, "missing governed traded-share daily bars"
missing = expected - set(sides)
assert len(missing) / len(expected) <= 0.02, "partial coverage"
assert compact_rows > 0 and rows == manifest["row_count"]
assert compressed == manifest["bytes"] == receipt["bytes_compressed"] <= KEYED_DATASETS["tw_broker_top"].day_budget_bytes
assert 0 <= receipt["requests_made"] <= 1 <= receipt["plan_hourly_cap"]
assert store.read_manifest(day) == manifest, "partition changed during probe; retry after refresh"
print(json.dumps({"trade_date": day, "symbols_with_both_sides": len(sides), "expected_traded_shares": len(expected), "missing": len(missing), "rows": rows, "compact_rows": compact_rows, "bytes_compressed": compressed, "bytes_uncompressed": uncompressed, "receipt_bytes_uncompressed": receipt["bytes_uncompressed"], "requests_made": receipt["requests_made"], "keyed_retention_sessions": KEYED_DATASETS["tw_broker_top"].retention_sessions, "result": "pass"}, sort_keys=True))
